# Aggregate roster by org title and emeritus flag, then join to organizations by name; exclude org numbers 139 and 250; add totals per hierarchy type.

# 1) Aggregate roster by hr_org_unit_title
roster_sql = """
WITH roster_clean AS (
  SELECT 
    TRIM(hr_org_unit_title) AS org_title,
    CASE 
      WHEN emeritus_status IS NULL OR TRIM(emeritus_status) = '' OR LOWER(emeritus_status) = 'none' THEN 'Non-Emeritus'
      WHEN LOWER(emeritus_status) LIKE '%emeritus%' THEN 'Emeritus'
      ELSE 'Non-Emeritus'
    END AS emeritus_flag
  FROM faculty_roster
)
SELECT 
  org_title,
  emeritus_flag,
  COUNT(*) AS headcount
FROM roster_clean
GROUP BY org_title, emeritus_flag
"""
roster_df = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, roster_sql)

# Register aggregated roster for SQL joining
db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, roster_df, "tmp_roster_counts")

# 2) Create final table by joining to organizations on organization_name and to org_hierarchy on dlc_name
final_sql = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH org_base AS (
  SELECT 
    o.organization_key,
    o.organization_id,
    o.organization AS org_code,
    o.organization_name AS org_name,
    o.organization_level AS org_level,
    CAST(o.organization_number AS VARCHAR) AS organization_number
  FROM organizations o
  WHERE CAST(o.organization_number AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('139','250')
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    ob.organization_key,
    ob.organization_id,
    ob.org_code,
    ob.org_name,
    ob.org_level,
    ob.organization_number,
    COALESCE(r.emeritus_flag,'Non-Emeritus') AS member_status,
    COALESCE(r.headcount,0) AS employer_count
  FROM org_base ob
  LEFT JOIN tmp_roster_counts r
    ON r.org_title = ob.org_name
),
formatted AS (
  SELECT 
    j.organization_key,
    j.organization_id,
    j.org_code,
    j.org_name,
    j.org_level,
    j.organization_number,
    j.member_status,
    j.employer_count,
    CASE WHEN j.org_level >= 3 THEN j.org_name || ' (Level ' || CAST(j.org_level AS VARCHAR) || ')'
         ELSE j.org_name END AS formatted_name
  FROM joined j
),
with_hier AS (
  SELECT 
    f.organization_key,
    f.organization_id,
    f.org_code,
    f.org_name,
    f.org_level,
    f.organization_number,
    f.member_status,
    f.employer_count,
    f.formatted_name,
    h.hierarchy_type
  FROM formatted f
  LEFT JOIN org_hierarchy h
    ON h.dlc_name = f.org_name
)
SELECT 
  hierarchy_type,
  org_code AS break_group,
  organization_id,
  org_name AS organization_name,
  formatted_name,
  organization_number,
  org_level AS level,
  member_status,
  employer_count
FROM with_hier
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  hierarchy_type,
  'TOTAL' AS break_group,
  NULL AS organization_id,
  'All Orgs' AS organization_name,
  'All Orgs' AS formatted_name,
  NULL AS organization_number,
  NULL AS level,
  'Total' AS member_status,
  SUM(employer_count) AS employer_count
FROM with_hier
GROUP BY hierarchy_type
ORDER BY hierarchy_type NULLS LAST, break_group, member_status
"""

db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, final_sql)
